```{r}
# Individual level traits

# Integrated UVP results

# Comparison between POC flux and lipid pump C flux
```

# Generalized additive models
Predictors are depth, latitude, sampling day and year

## LPC flux
```{r}
df.profile.lpc <- df.profile %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(station_year, DOY) %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) )

# GAM of LPC flux with bottom depth, latitude, and sampling day and year as predictors
# Running s(depth) + s(lat) VS te(depth, lat) yields similar models. ti(depth, latitude) has no significant interaction effect
mod.lpc <- gam(
  total_gC_flux_m2 ~ s(bottom_depth_m) + s(latitude) + s(DOY) + Year, 
  data = df.profile.lpc,
  method = "REML")

# GAM results
summary(mod.lpc)

plot(mod.lpc, scheme = 2)
gam.check(mod.lpc) # note that pvalue here is for the residuals, so better if not sigdif

# Fit bottom depth vs LPC flux
fit.depth <- data.frame(
  bottom_depth_m = seq(min(df.profile.lpc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                       max(df.profile.lpc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                       length.out = 200),
  Year = mean(df.profile.lpc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  DOY = mean(df.profile.lpc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
  latitude = mean(df.profile.lpc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred <- predict(mod.lpc, newdata = fit.depth, se.fit = TRUE)

# get fit and 95% confidence interval
fit.depth$fit <- pred$fit
fit.depth$lwr <- pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit
fit.depth$upr <- pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit


# Fit latitude vs LPC flux
fit.lat <- data.frame(
  latitude = seq(min(df.profile.lpc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                       max(df.profile.lpc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                       length.out = 208),
  Year = mean(df.profile.lpc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  DOY = mean(df.profile.lpc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
  bottom_depth_m = mean(df.profile.lpc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred2 <- predict(mod.lpc, newdata = fit.lat, se.fit = TRUE)

fit.lat$fit <- pred2$fit
fit.lat$lwr <- pred2$fit - 1.96 * pred2$se.fit
fit.lat$upr <- pred2$fit + 1.96 * pred2$se.fit


# Fit doy vs LPC flux
fit.doy <- data.frame(
  DOY = seq(min(df.profile.lpc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
                       max(df.profile.lpc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
                       length.out = 208),
  Year = mean(df.profile.lpc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  latitude = mean(df.profile.lpc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  bottom_depth_m = mean(df.profile.lpc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred3 <- predict(mod.lpc, newdata = fit.doy, se.fit = TRUE)

fit.doy$fit <- pred3$fit
fit.doy$lwr <- pred3$fit - 1.96 * pred3$se.fit
fit.doy$upr <- pred3$fit + 1.96 * pred3$se.fit

```


## POC flux
```{r}
df.profile.poc <- flux.com.profiles.200 %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(station_year, DOY, Year, bottom_depth_m,
                     latitude = object_lat) %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T)  )

# GAM of POC flux at 200 m 
# The k for latitude is set to max 5 (resulting in edF ~2) this was done because the s(latitude) edf of ~ 7 is too squiggly and is not ecologically meaningful.
mod.poc <- gam(
  poc_mgC_m2_d ~ s(bottom_depth_m) + s(latitude, k = 5) + 
   s(DOY) + Year ,
  data = df.profile.poc,
  method = "REML"
)

summary(mod.poc)

# Fit POC flux at 200m vs bottom depth
fit.depth.poc <- data.frame(
  bottom_depth_m = seq(min(df.profile.poc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                       max(df.profile.poc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                       length.out = 148),
  Year = mean(df.profile.poc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  DOY = mean(df.profile.poc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
  latitude = mean(df.profile.poc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred <- predict(mod.poc, newdata = fit.depth.poc, se.fit = TRUE)

fit.depth.poc$fit <- pred$fit
fit.depth.poc$lwr <- pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit
fit.depth.poc$upr <- pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit


# Fit POC flux at 200m vs latitude
fit.lat.poc <- data.frame(
  latitude = seq(min(df.profile.poc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(df.profile.poc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                 length.out = 148),
  Year = mean(df.profile.poc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  DOY = mean(df.profile.poc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
  bottom_depth_m = mean(df.profile.poc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred2 <- predict(mod.poc, newdata = fit.lat.poc, se.fit = TRUE)

fit.lat.poc$fit <- pred2$fit
fit.lat.poc$lwr <- pred2$fit - 1.96 * pred2$se.fit
fit.lat.poc$upr <- pred2$fit + 1.96 * pred2$se.fit

plot(mod.poc, scheme = 3)
gam.check(mod.poc) # the p-value of the latitude k-index is low as expected


# Fit doy vs LPC flux
fit.doy.poc <- data.frame(
  DOY = seq(min(df.profile.poc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
            max(df.profile.poc$DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
            length.out = 208),
  Year = mean(df.profile.poc$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
  latitude = mean(df.profile.poc$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  bottom_depth_m = mean(df.profile.poc$bottom_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred3 <- predict(mod.poc, newdata = fit.doy.poc, se.fit = TRUE)

fit.doy.poc$fit <- pred3$fit
fit.doy.poc$lwr <- pred3$fit - 1.96 * pred3$se.fit
fit.doy.poc$upr <- pred3$fit + 1.96 * pred3$se.fit

```

# --- Regional GAM fits ---
# LPC flux vs bottom depth by region
## Regional GAM fits
```{r}
# fit one GAM ~ bottom depth per reg.inuk group, used to determine how much depth explains variability of LPC flux. 
mods.lpc.reg <- df.profile.lpc %>%
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  set_names(levels(df.profile.lpc$reg.inuk)) %>%
  map(~ gam(
    total_gC_flux_m2 ~ 
      s(bottom_depth_m),
    data = .x,
    method = "REML"
  ))

# model-level metrics
model_metrics <- imap_dfr(mods.lpc.reg, ~ {
  s <- summary(.x)
  
  tibble(
    reg.inuk = .y,
    r.sq.adj = s$r.sq,
    dev.expl = s$dev.expl,
    n = nobs(.x)
  )
})

# extract parametric term stats
parametric_stats <- imap_dfr(mods.lpc.reg, ~ {
  broom::tidy(.x, parametric = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(reg.inuk = .y)
})

# extract smooth term stats
smooth_stats <- imap_dfr(mods.lpc.reg, ~ {
  broom::tidy(.x, parametric = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(reg.inuk = .y)
})

# combine into one dataframe
gam_stats <- bind_rows(
  parametric_stats %>% mutate(term_type = "parametric"),
  smooth_stats %>% mutate(term_type = "smooth"))  %>%
  left_join(model_metrics, by = "reg.inuk") %>% 
  relocate(reg.inuk,  n, r.sq.adj, dev.expl) %>% 
  arrange(reg.inuk) %>% 
  mutate(is.sig = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "true", "false")) 

# Export GAM stats
# write.csv(gam_stats, file = "tables/GAM_subregions_20260528.csv",
#           row.names = F)

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Difference in average fluxes

  mutate(isFjord = if_else(station_year %in% fjord.stations$station_year,

  group_by(region.inuk, isFjord) %>% 
  summarise(lpc_mean = mean(total_gC_flux_m2),

  mutate(fjord_region = paste(region.inuk, isFjord)) %>% 
  filter(region.inuk %in% c("Nares Strait","Pikialasorsuaq","Qikiqtaaluk Shelf"))

                     ymax = lpc_mean + lpc_sd),
                 linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  theme(legend.position = "none",
```

# Size gradient with depth
## Calculate CWM traits
```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
# Calculate community weighted mean of mean traits (weighted by abundance)
cwm.profiles <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # only include Calanus spp
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # add volume filtered
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max / 5) * 5 + 2.5) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df) %>% 
  # add regions
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuk, reg.inuk, station_year)) %>% 
  # filter samples for analysis
  filter(!is.na(region.inuk)) %>% 
  # calculate portion of the volume to get relative abundance
  mutate(rel_abundance = Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  mutate(temperature_C = temperature_kelvin - 273.15) %>% 
  select(station_year, region.inuk, reg.inuk, rel_abundance,
         prosome_length_mm, lipid_fullness, waxester_mass_mgC, temperature_C,
         respirationRate_ugCday, diapauseDuration_day, 
         structural_carbon_mgC, prosome_total_mgC) %>% 
  # # Cap diapause duration?
  # mutate(diapauseDuration_day = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
  #                                       240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, region.inuk, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ weighted.mean(.x, rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nindivs = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  select(-rel_abundance) %>% 
  # Add bottom depth information
  left_join(df.profile %>% 
              select(station_year, bottom_depth_m))

cwm.profiles.long <- cwm.profiles %>% 
  select(-c(prosome_total_mgC, structural_carbon_mgC)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prosome_length_mm, lipid_fullness, waxester_mass_mgC,
                        respirationRate_ugCday, diapauseDuration_day,
                        temperature_C),
               names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, 
                        levels = c("prosome_length_mm", "waxester_mass_mgC",
                                   "respirationRate_ugCday", "lipid_fullness", 
                                   "diapauseDuration_day", "temperature_C")))
  

flabels <- c("prosome_length_mm" = "a. Prosome length\n(mm)",
```

# Establish traits from LOKI images and literature
Same as in file 9-hydrobios_lipid_pump.Rmd, needed to convert net abundance to biomass
```{r}
loki.segmentations <- read.csv("data/LOKI_Bourreau_manuscript/merged_LOKI2013_ecotaxa_masks_features.csv") %>% 
 
# match trait names
  mutate(total_carbon = prosome_carbon_volume + total_lipids_ugC/1000,
         lf_carbon = total_lipids_ugC/1000 / total_carbon * 100,
         waxester_carbon = total_lipids_ugC / 1000) %>% 
  #  # Recalculated version (lipid carbon not based on the variable total_lipids_carbon_volume)
  # mutate(lf_carbon = waxester_carbon / (waxester_carbon + prosome_carbon_volume) * 100) %>% 
  select(object_id, object_annotation_category,
         prosome_length_mm = prosome_major_axis_mm,
         prosome_biovolume_mm3 = prosome_volume_mm3,
         structural_carbon_mgC = prosome_carbon_volume,
         waxester_carbon_mgC = waxester_carbon,
         total_carbon_mgC = total_carbon, 
         lf_carbon) %>% 
  mutate(source = "LOKI segmented") %>% 
  mutate(taxaStage = case_when(
    object_annotation_category == 
      "female+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus F",
    object_annotation_category == 
      "cvstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus C5",
    object_annotation_category == 
      "civstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus C4",
    object_annotation_category == 
      "female+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis F",
    object_annotation_category ==
      "cvstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis C5",
    object_annotation_category == 
      "civstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis C4",
    TRUE ~ object_annotation_category ) )

# Calculate average by taxa stage
loki.averages <- loki.segmentations %>% 
  group_by(taxaStage) %>% 
  summarise(across(prosome_length_mm:lf_carbon,
                   \(x) mean(x, na.rm = T)),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  select(taxaStage, total_carbon_mgC, waxester_carbon_mgC, lf_carbon, n)

# C.finmarchicus derived from literature (Pata and Hunt 2023) (CV averages from Durazzano & Titocci, 2025 and C&DW of 59% from Pata & Hunt 2023)
Cfin <- data.frame(
  taxaStage = c("Calanus finmarchicus F", "Calanus finmarchicus C5"),
  total_carbon_mgC = c(0.2055, 0.1617), # DW * 0.59 C%DW
  waxester_carbon_mgC = c(0.0885,0.0445) # DW * 0.34 Lipid%DW * 0.81 WE%Lipid
) %>% 
  mutate(lf_carbon = waxester_carbon_mgC / total_carbon_mgC * 100)

Calanus.traits <- bind_rows(loki.averages, Cfin)

rm(loki.segmentations, loki.averages, Cfin)
```


# Check taxonomic composition by bottom depth. Where are C. glacialis vs C. hyperboreus
```{r}
# Net data
load("data/hydrobios_net_calanus_20260321.RData")

net.bot.depths <- uvp_net_match %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = paste(cruise_year, STATION_NAME)) %>% 
  distinct(YEAR_STATION, BOTTOM_DEPTH) %>% 
  arrange(BOTTOM_DEPTH)


calanus.by.depth <- calanus %>% 
  left_join(net.bot.depths,
            by = join_by(YEAR_STATION)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = factor(YEAR_STATION, 
                               levels = net.bot.depths$YEAR_STATION)) %>% 
  mutate(tax_stage = paste(TAXON_ID, TAXON_LIFE_DEV_STAGE)) %>% 
   group_by(YEAR_STATION, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
           TAXON_ID, tax_stage, BOTTOM_DEPTH) %>% 
  summarise(total_abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            mean_abundance_m3 = weighted.mean(abundance_m3, w = Depth_range),
            total_indiv_count = sum(indiv_count),
            maxDepth = max(MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH),
            nbins = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Add carbon traits
  mutate(tax_stage = str_replace(tax_stage,"M","F")) %>% # use the F traits for M
  left_join(Calanus.traits %>% 
              select(tax_stage = taxaStage, carbonWeight = total_carbon_mgC),
            by = "tax_stage") %>% 
  # Calculate biomass
  mutate(total_biomass_mgC_m2 = total_abundance_m2 * carbonWeight)

ggplot(calanus.by.depth, aes(x = YEAR_STATION, y = total_abundance_m2,

  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black") +

                     labels = c(0,25,50,75,100),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  ylab("% Abundance") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1), 
                     labels = c(0,25,50,75,100),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  ylab("% Biomass") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

# Species composition of nets by region
# Calculate net integrated abundance and biomass
species.comp.station <- calanus.by.depth %>%
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
           TAXON_ID, BOTTOM_DEPTH) %>% 
  summarise(total_abundance_m2 = sum(total_abundance_m2),
            total_biomass_mgC_m2 = sum(total_biomass_mgC_m2),
            nbins = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(TAXON_ID = case_match(TAXON_ID,
                               "Calanus finmarchicus" ~ "Calanus finmarchicus CV-F",
                               "Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis CIV-F",
                               "Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus CIV-F")) %>% 
  # relative abundance
  group_by(YEAR_STATION) %>% 
  mutate(assem_abundance_m2 = sum(total_abundance_m2)) %>% 
  mutate(assem_biomass_mgC_m2 = sum(total_biomass_mgC_m2)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(relative_abundance = total_abundance_m2/assem_abundance_m2*100) %>% 
  mutate(relative_biomass = total_biomass_mgC_m2/assem_biomass_mgC_m2*100) %>%
  mutate(total_biomass_gC_m2 = total_biomass_mgC_m2 / 1000) %>% 
  left_join(uvp_net_match %>% 
              distinct(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
                       LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, reg.inuk),
            by = join_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START))


ggplot(species.comp.station, aes(x = YEAR_STATION, y = total_abundance_m2,
                                fill = TAXON_ID)) +

  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1),

  ylab("% Biomass") +
```

# Extra: Estimating grazing pressure and fecal pellet production by individuals at the upper 200 m
```{r}
surface.assemblage <- df.station.100m %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m))) %>% 
  filter(Depth_100m < 200) %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  select(station_year, Depth_100m, depth_height_m, Sampled_volume_m3,
         abundance_m2, biomass_gC_m2) %>% 
  # sum upper 200 m biomass
  group_by(station_year) %>% 
  summarise(total_abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            total_biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2),
            total_sampled_vol_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            total_depth_sampled_m = sum(depth_height_m),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuk, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "station_year")

ggplot(surface.assemblage, 
       aes(x = bottom_depth_m, y = total_biomass_gC_m2)) +
  geom_smooth() +
  geom_point(aes(color = region.inuk)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs)

# average surface abundance and biomass per region
surface.assemblage.region <- surface.assemblage %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(mean_surface_abundance_m2 = mean(total_abundance_m2),
            sd_surface_abundance_m2 = sd(total_abundance_m2),
            mean_surface_biomass_m2 = mean(total_biomass_gC_m2),
            sd_surface_biomass_m2 = sd(total_biomass_gC_m2),
            nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

# rough C budgets
region.C.budgets <- df.region %>% 
  select(region.inuktitut, n,
         biomass_gC_m2_mean, biomass_gC_m2_sd) %>% 
  mutate(ingestion_gC_d = biomass_gC_m2_mean * 0.01, # conservative 1% of carbon weight ingested per day
         egestion_gC_d = ingestion_gC_d * 0.57) %>% 
  mutate(grazing_pressure_90 = ingestion_gC_d * 90,
         egestion_gC_90d = egestion_gC_d * 90) %>% 
  # How much of the fecal pellets will reach 200m export?
  # 10% of egestion exits epipelagic
  mutate(egestion_gC_90d_export200m = egestion_gC_90d * 0.1) %>% 
  # % relative to NPP of 40 g C m-2 yr-1
  mutate(grazed_NPP = grazing_pressure_90/40*100,
         egested_NPP = egestion_gC_90d_export200m/40*100)
```
